Off Calendar Jul-14-2003 Judgment Entered
MINI MINUTES: This Cause came as assigned from the Presiding Judge Master Calendar for Court Trial.
Judge: Ollie Marie-Victoire, Clerk: S. Ravinantapricha, CSR: Ann Mendoza.
Stephen Sherman, Esq., for Plaintiff: Art Walker.
No appearance by the Defendants: William rossi and David Bush.
09:50 am. - Plaintiff's witness, Art Walker was sworn and direct examined by counsel.
PLTF EXH #1 - Lease agreement --------------- ID/EVID.
PLTF EXH #2 - Three day notice --------------- ID/EVID.
The Court having heard the testimony and considered the evidence, grants judgment as follows:
Judgment in favor of plaintiff and against defendant for restitution and possession of the premises at:
2632 Post St., San Francisco.
Unpaid rent through March in the amount of $10,800.00
Per Diem Damages from April 1, 2003 through July 14, 2003 of $8,040.00
Attorney's Fees from Defendant: William E. Rossi for the amount of $2,225.00
Sanctions pursuant to the order of Commissioner Norris dated June 26, 2003 in the amount of $1,050.00
Lease between plaintiff and defendants is declared forfeited.
Counsel stipulated for return of exhibits.
Judgment signed in open court.
